span.p:
Developer Commit / PR
branch: dev
Triggers CI pipeline

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dev CI Workflow
dev-ci.yml
Handles both dev pushes and environment promotions
Calls reusable workflows for modular automation:

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ci-app.yml → Build · Test · Lint · Push App Imageci-manifests.yml → Validate Manifests (Yamllint · KubeScore · Conftest · Kustomize · IaC Checkov Scan)
ci-gitops-bump.yml → Bump newTag in Kustomization files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitOps Repo
manifests/overlays/dev
Defines Development environment
Watched by Argo CD (auto-sync)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Merge dev → stage
Promotion triggered within dev-ci.yml

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same reusable workflows as in dev but won’t build and push. Gets image pushed in dev:
SKIP ci-app.yml · ci-manifests.yml · ci-gitops-bump.yml

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitOps Repo
manifests/overlays/stage
Defines Staging environment
Argo CD auto-sync enabled

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Merge stage → prod
Promotion triggered within dev-ci.yml

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same reusable workflows as in stage but won’t build and push. Gets image pushed in stage:
SKIP ci-app.yml · ci-manifests.yml · ci-gitops-bump.yml

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GitOps Repo
manifests/overlays/prod
Defines Production environment
Argo CD manual sync

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Argo CD App: react-portfolio-dev
auto-sync: enabled
Continuously reconciles dev overlay

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Argo CD App: react-portfolio-stage
auto-sync: enabled
Continuously reconciles stage overlay

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Argo CD App: react-portfolio-prod
auto-sync: disabled
Manual sync triggers prod release

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MetalLB + Ingress + Cloudflare Tunnel
Hosts all three environments

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rollback: revert image tag manually
in overlay file (dev, stage, or prod)
Argo CD auto-sync restores previous version
(No CI re-run required)
